messages:
mia_billing: Quick help — customer NimbusCo attempted payment with a virtual card and we got 'authorization_window_expired'. Invoice INV-2301 for $6,420 is now unpaid. Any quick recovery paths? @csm_derek

ops_kyla: That decline usually means the card was issued with a short auth window and our capture was delayed. Do we have the original auth token?

payments-bot: Stripe event: `charge_failed` -> decline_reason: authorization_window_expired; payment_method: card_virt_***; auth_code: auth_98765; logged to /payments/INV-2301.

csm_derek: Customer says their procurement tool auto-rotates virtual cards every 24h; they can re-issue a new VC immediately. They prefer to avoid ACH.

mia_billing: Options: 1) Send secure retry link so they can re-run card (best UX), 2) Ask them to provide new VC details and we charge via support secure form, 3) Offer ACH/wire fallback and extend due date 3 days. Thoughts?

treasury_alex: For $6.4k we require payer confirmation for ACH. If they re-issue VC, make sure 3DS not required; if tokenized via our vault we can attempt immediate capture. Approve retry link + one scheduled retry in 4 hours.

visa-bot: Note: some merchant category codes trigger shorter auth windows for virtual cards; if this recurs, consider adding a pre-authorization step within 1 hour of invoice creation.

mia_billing: I'll email AP with retry link and short instructions: "Please re-issue your virtual card and click the secure payment link to complete payment. If you'd rather we accept ACH, reply and we'll provide instructions and extend by 72h." cc @csm_derek

csm_derek: I'll follow up by phone if no reply in 2 hours. Customer is responsive.

payments-bot: Hosted retry link created: https://pay.redwood/retry/INV-2301-xyz (expires 24h). Scheduled one automated retry at +4h. Dunning paused for 72h.

ops_kyla: Filed feature request BL-4945: "attempt immediate pre-auth capture upon invoice creation for VC payment methods to avoid auth window expiry".

mia_billing: Customer re-issued VC and used the retry link; payment captured. Marking invoice paid, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
